title: Offline Multimodal Large Language Models for Decision Support in Air Operations
abstract: arXiv:2609.21390v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Air operations rely on complex rules, established procedures, and time-critical analysis under limited connectivity and strict security constraints. In such environments, analysts must combine written doctrine with images, often without access to external computing resources. This paper studies offline large language models as decision support tools, deployed in isolated and restricted environments to give analysts access to doctrinal knowledge that remains traceable to its original sources through natural language interaction. We describe a modular retrieval-augmented architecture suitable for operation without Internet connectivity, supporting both text and image input from technical manuals. translated_title: 面向空中作战决策支持的离线多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 空中作战依赖于复杂的规则、既定的程序，以及在有限连接性和严格安全约束下的时间关键型分析。在这种环境中，分析师必须将书面条令与图像相结合，且通常无法访问外部计算资源。本文研究将离线大语言模型作为决策支持工具，部署在隔离和受限制的环境中，通过自然语言交互让分析师能够访问可追溯至原始来源的条令知识。我们描述了一种适用于无互联网连接运行的模块化检索增强架构，支持来自技术手册的文本和图像输入。作为评估该架构的第一步，我们报告了一项与四名巴西空军图像分析师合作开展的试点研究，结合了基于其电子目标识别条令的条令知识评估，对人……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需互联网连接、支持文本与图像输入的模块化检索增强多模态大语言模型架构，可在隔离受限环境中为空中作战分析师提供可溯源至原始文献的条令知识决策支持，并通过巴西空军分析师的试点研究进行了初步评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a modular retrieval-augmented multimodal LLM architecture that operates without internet connectivity, providing air operations analysts with traceable doctrinal knowledge for decision support in isolated and restricted environments, evaluated through a pilot study with Brazilian Air Force image analysts.
